source.title: An analysis of the Big Gaps found in the Liber Primus
source.author: CurtbroG

method: Freeze the author's 16 and 15 page lists; recalculate the printed arithmetic and archived JPEG file sizes. Compare both lists and all 58 LP2 originals. Estimate a fixed-label permutation reference for the difference in mean file bytes using 100,000 seeded random 16-versus-15 splits of these 31 files. The lists were chosen after looking at gaps and sizes, so this reference is descriptive, not a discovery p-value.
exclusions: This does not classify image gap widths, infer font behavior, or test a decryption. The original post's images and measurement coordinates are not preserved in the supplied text.
